description: Built a responsive banking application during a web development internship, implementing user account management, transaction workflows, and a clear customer-facing interface with HTML and CSS.
Developed a Python machine-learning model for cancer detection from human-cell data, taking the project from preprocessing and feature extraction through classification and model optimization.

Built Java, Selenium, and Apache HTTP automation for UI and REST API regression suites in Jenkins, reducing manual test cycles by approximately 40%. Automated multi-cloud environment setup and deployments with Chef, cutting manual setup work by approximately 70% across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Oracle. Developed 8+ Java utilities and API health checks, monitored 15+ QA environments with Prometheus, Grafana, and MySQL, and resolved 15+ high-severity incidents through Elasticsearch and Kibana analysis.

Support endpoint, software, account, network, and peripheral incidents through ServiceNow while maintaining asset records and triaging malware and phishing reports. Built and deployed a Dockerized printer operations service on Ubuntu/Proxmox with a web interface, centralized inventory, Slack workflows, and automated toner and emergency IT alerts. Repurposed a Dell PowerEdge R440 as a Proxmox host, using iDRAC to monitor hardware and provision virtual machines for ASU Windows image and policy testing.
